remarks: Charming and updated 4-bedroom Colonial set on a beautifully landscaped lot in the heart of Darien. This inviting home features a sun-filled living room with hardwood floors and a formal dining area. Upstairs, you'll find four spacious bedrooms and two bathrooms. The private backyard offers a perfect space for relaxing or entertaining with a stone patio and lush greenery. Conveniently located near top-rated schools, shopping, train, and all that downtown Darien has to offer. A rare opportunity to enjoy suburban living with easy access to everything. Pet Friendly! (Cats & Small Dogs under 35 lbs.)
